description: Source code for NVMe command handling in Zephyr OS, including request management, completion processing, and error handling.

methods.name: request_timeout
methods.description: Handles request timeout, checks for timed-out requests, and triggers retries or cleanup.

methods.name: nvme_completion_is_retry
methods.description: Determines if a completion status indicates a retryable error.

methods.name: nvme_cmd_request_complete
methods.description: Processes completion of an NVMe request, handles retries, and invokes callback.

methods.name: nvme_cmd_qpair_process_completion
methods.description: Processes completion queue entries for a given queue pair.

methods.name: nvme_cmd_qpair_msi_handler
methods.description: Interrupt handler for NVMe queue pair MSI interrupts.

methods.name: nvme_cmd_qpair_setup
methods.description: Initializes and configures an NVMe queue pair.

methods.name: nvme_cmd_qpair_reset
methods.description: Resets the queue pair to initial state.

methods.name: nvme_cmd_qpair_fill_prp_list
methods.description: Allocates and fills a PRP list for data transfer.

methods.name: compute_n_prp
methods.description: Calculates the number of PRP entries needed for a data buffer.

methods.name: nvme_cmd_qpair_fill_dptr
methods.description: Fills the data pointer fields in a command based on request type.

methods.name: nvme_cmd_qpair_submit_request
methods.description: Submits an NVMe request to the queue pair for execution.

methods.name: nvme_completion_swapbytes
methods.description: Swaps byte order of completion structure fields.
